name: BranchDeck
tagline: Keep your worktrees, commands, and terminals in context
description: Juggling Codex, Claude Code, and several Git worktrees? BranchDeck keeps each local checkout, useful commands, and running terminals together on macOS. Find the right workspace, test a feature, and return to your dev server while the app stays running. Discovery happens locally; no BranchDeck account required. Free preview for Apple Silicon Macs. Current interface: Chinese.
status: Successfully scheduled on Product Hunt for 2026-10-11 at 00:01 America/Los_Angeles (15:01 Asia/Shanghai).
